title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Claim-History Factor When a Duplicate Payment Is Re-Settled
content:
**Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan — duplicate re-settlement.** The deductible subtracted on the re-settlement is multiplied by the duplicate re-settlement's claim-history factor: 1.75 when three or more other paid claims on the plan have a loss date in the 36 whole months before the handling date, 1.5 when exactly two do, 1.25 when exactly one does, and 1 when none does.

**Points of judgement.**
1. "Other" paid claims exclude the claim being re-settled.
2. A paid claim is a claim of this plan whose handling status is paid.
3. The 36 whole months run back from the handling date and are tested against each claim's loss date.

**Hypothetical case.** Besides the claim re-settled, the plan has one paid claim with a loss date 20 months before the handling date and one with a loss date 40 months before: one other paid claim in the window, so the multiplier is 1.25.
